milestones.text: finished their first {hobby} piece and did not hide it in a drawer
milestones.post: Not hiding it. Here it is.

milestones.text: set up a little corner at home just for {hobby}
milestones.post: My art corner is ready.

milestones.text: spent a whole afternoon on {hobby} without noticing the time go
milestones.post: Afternoon gone. No regrets.

milestones.text: showed their first {hobby} attempt to a friend, who squinted and then smiled
milestones.post: They squinted. Then they smiled. I'll take it.

milestones.text: got their first proper supplies for {hobby}
milestones.post: Proper supplies. Now there are no excuses.

milestones.text: made ten tiny practice pieces in one sitting
milestones.post: Ten little tries. One is okay!

milestones.text: studied one famous work for an hour to see how it was put together
milestones.post: An hour with one picture. Learned loads.

milestones.text: made it through their first month of {hobby} without quitting
milestones.post: A month in. Still going.

milestones.text: started keeping a notebook of ideas for {hobby}
milestones.post: Ideas notebook started. Already three pages.

milestones.text: finished a piece they liked enough to keep on display
milestones.post: This one gets to stay out.

milestones.text: noticed a mistake and fixed it instead of starting over
milestones.post: Fixed instead of restarting. Growth.

milestones.text: kept a {hobby} habit going for three months
milestones.post: Three months. Showing up counts.

milestones.text: made a birthday gift that went straight onto a wall
milestones.post: My gift went straight on the wall.

milestones.text: found a subject they keep coming back to
milestones.post: I think I have a favourite subject now.

milestones.text: put their first piece next to their newest and saw how far they had come
milestones.post: First piece versus now. Oh, look at that.

milestones.text: joined a small group of local artists who meet every week
milestones.post: Found my people. They meet on Thursdays.

milestones.text: tried a style they would never have dared a month ago
milestones.post: New style. Scary. Fun.

milestones.text: got a genuine compliment from a working artist
milestones.post: A real artist said it was good. Floating.

milestones.text: had a stranger ask whether a piece was for sale
milestones.post: Someone wanted to buy it. Didn't see that coming.

milestones.text: finished their most ambitious piece yet, over many evenings
milestones.post: Many evenings, one piece. My biggest yet.

milestones.text: taught a friend the basics of {hobby} in one afternoon
milestones.post: Teaching is the best way to learn.

milestones.text: made a series of pieces that clearly belong together
milestones.post: A series! They look like siblings.

milestones.text: had a piece hung in a neighbour's shop window
milestones.post: My work is in a shop window.

milestones.text: developed a style friends could recognise at a glance
milestones.post: 'That's yours, isn't it?' Yes. Yes it is.

milestones.text: finished a piece without second-guessing a single choice
milestones.post: No second-guessing. Just made it.

milestones.text: sold their first piece of work
milestones.post: First sale. Thinking of framing the coin.

milestones.text: made one small {hobby} study every day for a whole season
milestones.post: One a day all season. Done.

milestones.text: was asked to teach a beginners' class in {hobby}
milestones.post: Teaching beginners. Brushing up first.

milestones.text: had three pieces accepted into a local exhibition
milestones.post: Three pieces on the wall at the exhibition.

milestones.text: took on their first paid commission
milestones.post: First commission. Gulp.

milestones.text: won a ribbon at the town art show
milestones.post: A ribbon! For art!

milestones.text: had their work chosen to hang in the town hall
milestones.post: Town hall wall. My work. Wow.

milestones.text: sold every piece they brought to the market
milestones.post: Sold out. Going home light.

milestones.text: was asked for advice by a newer artist
milestones.post: Someone asked me for advice. Me!

milestones.text: finished a piece that would have been out of reach a year ago
milestones.post: A year ago I couldn't. Today I did.

milestones.text: filled a portfolio with work they were proud of
milestones.post: Full portfolio. No filler.

milestones.text: had a whole exhibition of nothing but their own work
milestones.post: A solo show. My name on the door.

milestones.text: won first prize at a regional art show
milestones.post: First prize. Still shaking.

milestones.text: was commissioned to make a piece for a public building
milestones.post: My work is going in a public building.

milestones.text: had a waiting list for commissions
milestones.post: There's a waiting list. I'm stunned.

milestones.text: was invited to judge the amateur section of an art show
milestones.post: Judging this year. Being gentle.

milestones.text: took on a student who wanted to learn {hobby} properly
milestones.post: I have a student. How did this happen?

milestones.text: had a piece bought by a serious collector
milestones.post: A collector bought one. A real collector.

milestones.text: finished what they consider the best thing they have ever made
milestones.post: Best thing I've made. I just know it.

milestones.text: had one of their pieces asked for by an admired teacher
milestones.post: My old teacher wanted to keep one. Floored.

milestones.text: mixed a green they actually meant to mix
milestones.post: Meant to make that green. Did.

milestones.text: painted their first sky without it turning to mud
milestones.post: Sky, not mud. Victory.

milestones.text: painted a bowl of fruit that looked good enough to eat
milestones.post: Someone reached for the painted apple.

milestones.text: learned to let one layer dry before adding the next
milestones.post: Patience is a paint colour.

milestones.text: finished a landscape outdoors in a single afternoon, before the light changed
milestones.post: Painted it on the spot before the light moved.

milestones.text: painted a portrait of a friend that is a true likeness
milestones.post: It looks like them! They agree!

milestones.text: painted waves that seem to move
milestones.post: The waves look wet. Somehow.

milestones.text: sold a painting at the summer art fair
milestones.post: A painting sold. Someone's wall is mine now.

milestones.text: painted a set of four seasons that hangs together as one
milestones.post: Spring to winter on one wall.

milestones.text: painted a large commissioned mural for the town square
milestones.post: The mural is done. The whole square sees it.

milestones.text: drew a hand that looks like a hand
milestones.post: Five fingers, all pointing the right way.

milestones.text: filled their first sketchbook cover to cover
milestones.post: First sketchbook full.

milestones.text: drew a recognisable portrait from life in under an hour
milestones.post: Under an hour. Recognisable.

milestones.text: got the perspective right on a whole street of houses
milestones.post: The houses all point the right way.

milestones.text: drew the same tree every day for a month
milestones.post: Thirty days, one tree.

milestones.text: drew a horse that really looks like it is galloping
milestones.post: The horse looks like it's moving.

milestones.text: drew a crowded market scene entirely from memory
milestones.post: All from memory. Busy little market.

milestones.text: sketched portraits at the fair for a whole afternoon
milestones.post: Twenty faces in one afternoon.

milestones.text: won the sketching contest at the summer fair
milestones.post: Best sketch at the fair. Mine.

milestones.text: had a series of their drawings bound into a book
milestones.post: My drawings, bound. Holding it very carefully.

milestones.text: took their first photograph that was neither blurry nor crooked
milestones.post: Not blurry. Not crooked. Framed it.

milestones.text: developed their first photograph in a darkroom
milestones.post: Watched it appear in the tray. Magic.

milestones.text: learned to judge exposure by eye on a bright day
milestones.post: Sunny day, perfect exposure.

milestones.text: switched off every automatic setting and shot a whole day in manual
milestones.post: Full manual all day. Survived.

milestones.text: caught a bird the instant it left its branch
milestones.post: Got the bird mid-flight. Pure patience.

milestones.text: took a family portrait that now sits on a neighbour's mantelpiece
milestones.post: Their family portrait is on the mantel. I took it.

milestones.text: had a print hung in the camera club exhibition
milestones.post: Camera club show. My print, framed.

milestones.text: was asked to photograph the whole town council, and nobody blinked
milestones.post: Whole council, one shot, nobody blinked.

milestones.text: had a photograph printed in the local newspaper
milestones.post: In the paper! Bought five copies.

milestones.text: won first prize in a photography competition with a street portrait
milestones.post: First prize for a portrait of a stranger.

milestones.text: wrote out a whole alphabet without a single blot
milestones.post: No blots. Entire alphabet.

milestones.text: learned to hold the pen at a steady angle for a full page
milestones.post: Steady angle, full page.

milestones.text: wrote out a short poem in a clean, even hand
milestones.post: A poem in my best hand.

milestones.text: mastered a second script well enough to use it
milestones.post: Two scripts now. Show-off.

milestones.text: lettered the names on a dozen certificates for the local school
milestones.post: Twelve certificates, no smudges.

milestones.text: lettered a shop sign that now hangs on the high street
milestones.post: My letters, over a shop door.

milestones.text: illuminated a capital letter in gold leaf
milestones.post: Gold leaf! My capital glows.

milestones.text: taught a small calligraphy class at the library
milestones.post: Six students, six steady pens.

milestones.text: lettered a full page of the town's commemorative book
milestones.post: My page is in the town's book now.

milestones.text: carved their first lino block and printed it backwards
milestones.post: Forgot to reverse it. Classic.

milestones.text: pulled a first print with even ink all over
milestones.post: Even ink. First try. Suspicious.

milestones.text: printed a run of twenty birthday cards from one block they carved
milestones.post: Twenty cards, one block.

milestones.text: printed a poster for a friend's gig
milestones.post: Poster for the gig. Ink everywhere.

milestones.text: lined up a two-colour print perfectly
milestones.post: Registration: nailed.

milestones.text: carved a block with lines so fine they printed cleanly
milestones.post: Hair-thin lines, crisp print.

milestones.text: sold a numbered edition of prints at a craft fair
milestones.post: Sold the edition. Numbered and signed.

milestones.text: ran a printmaking workshop at the community centre
milestones.post: Ink on every hand in the room. Perfect.

milestones.text: had a print accepted into a juried printmaking show
milestones.post: Juried show. Accepted. Breathing into a bag.

milestones.text: printed a series of twelve prints for a calendar that sold out
milestones.post: Twelve months, twelve prints, sold out.

milestones.text: finished their first drawing on a tablet
milestones.post: First tablet drawing. Undo is my best friend.

milestones.text: finally understood what layers are for
milestones.post: Layers. I see it now.

milestones.text: painted a full scene digitally without a reference
milestones.post: No reference. Just me and the stylus.

milestones.text: recorded a time-lapse video of a piece from blank canvas to finish
milestones.post: Three hours in thirty seconds. Hypnotic.

milestones.text: had a piece featured by a small online art community
milestones.post: Featured! The comments are so kind.

milestones.text: designed a set of stickers that friends actually use
milestones.post: My stickers are everywhere now.

milestones.text: took a paid commission to draw a streamer's profile picture
milestones.post: First paid digital commission.

milestones.text: sold a set of digital prints online in a weekend
milestones.post: Sold out over a weekend. What.

milestones.text: had a piece used as the cover art for a friend's indie game
milestones.post: My art is on a game cover.

milestones.text: finished a short animated piece, frame by frame
milestones.post: Every frame by hand. It moves!

milestones.text: modelled their first clay head, which looks a bit startled
milestones.post: A very startled little head.

milestones.text: learned to keep clay damp under a cloth between sessions
milestones.post: Covered my clay. It survives another day.

milestones.text: built a wire armature that held the clay up
milestones.post: The armature holds. The sculpture stands.

milestones.text: carved their first small piece from a block of wood
milestones.post: Wood is stubborn. I'm more stubborn.

milestones.text: carved a small figure from a block of soapstone
milestones.post: Soapstone figure, smooth as anything.

milestones.text: modelled a life-size bust of a friend
milestones.post: Life-size. They're a little unnerved.

milestones.text: had a sculpture shown at a local exhibition
milestones.post: My sculpture got its own plinth.

milestones.text: was commissioned to make a sculpture for a public garden
milestones.post: My sculpture will live among the roses.

milestones.text: had one of their pieces cast in bronze
milestones.post: Cast in bronze. It feels permanent now.

milestones.text: carried a small sketchbook everywhere for a month and filled it
milestones.post: A month of pocket sketches. Every page used.

milestones.text: painted a still life by candlelight and kept the glow
milestones.post: Candlelight is hard. Got it anyway.

milestones.text: drew a lifelike portrait of a neighbour's dog, which the dog ignored
milestones.post: The owner cried. The dog yawned.

milestones.text: lettered a family tree for a neighbour, five generations deep
milestones.post: Five generations, not a blot.

milestones.text: photographed the same street corner every season for a year
milestones.post: Four seasons, one corner. Lovely set.

milestones.text: got a clay figure through the kiln without a single crack
milestones.post: Into the kiln, out in one piece.

milestones.text: designed a poster for a local festival that went up all over town
milestones.post: My poster is on every lamppost.

milestones.text: carved a woodcut fine enough to print a portrait
milestones.post: A whole face carved in wood. Backwards.

milestones.text: finished a first piece without starting over
milestones.post: First one finished. No do-overs.

milestones.text: learned to sit still long enough to really look
milestones.post: Turns out looking is half of it.

milestones.text: found the corner of the house with the best light
milestones.post: Claimed the good window.

milestones.text: kept every practice sheet instead of throwing any away
milestones.post: Keeping the bad ones. Proof of progress.

milestones.text: made a small piece good enough to pin above the bed
milestones.post: Pinned it up. It stays.

milestones.text: stopped making excuses for early work
milestones.post: No more excuses. It's practice.

milestones.text: worked out how to hold the tools without cramping up
milestones.post: Loose grip, steadier line.

milestones.text: finished a piece in a single sitting
milestones.post: One sitting, one piece. Done.

milestones.text: copied an old master's work to learn how it was done
milestones.post: Borrowed a master's eye for a day.

milestones.text: spent a whole season on one subject until it came easily
milestones.post: Same subject all season. Now it comes easy.

milestones.text: got the proportions right on the first try
milestones.post: Measured by eye and it was right.

milestones.text: gave a small piece away as a gift
milestones.post: Gave one away. It's on someone's wall now.

milestones.text: noticed the light in a room as never before
milestones.post: I see light differently now.

milestones.text: filled a whole book of practice from cover to cover
milestones.post: Cover to cover. On to the next.

milestones.text: had a piece hung in a neighbour's front room
milestones.post: On a neighbour's wall. Strange and lovely.

milestones.text: was asked to make something for a wedding
milestones.post: A wedding piece. No pressure.

milestones.text: found a style that looks like nobody else's
milestones.post: It looks like mine now. Only mine.

milestones.text: worked on a large piece across a whole month of evenings
milestones.post: A month of evenings in one piece.

milestones.text: taught a younger cousin the basics over a long afternoon
milestones.post: Taught the basics. Patience required.

milestones.text: had a piece shown in the window of a local shop
milestones.post: In the shop window. I walked past twice.

milestones.text: finished a series of six pieces that belong together
milestones.post: Six pieces, one set.

milestones.text: kept working through a dull spell until the spark came back
milestones.post: The spark's back.

milestones.text: sold a piece to a buyer from out of town
milestones.post: Sold to someone from out of town.

milestones.text: was asked to take on a paid commission
milestones.post: First paid commission. Real money.

milestones.text: had a piece chosen for a local exhibition
milestones.post: Chosen for the exhibition. Still grinning.

milestones.text: was asked for advice by someone just starting out
milestones.post: Someone asked my advice. Me.

milestones.text: made a piece that now hangs in a public building
milestones.post: Hanging in public. For good.

milestones.text: finished a piece that took a whole year
milestones.post: A year's work, finished.

milestones.text: had a whole wall of their work shown together
milestones.post: A whole wall. All mine.

milestones.text: was praised by a well-known artist
milestones.post: Praise from someone I've admired forever.

milestones.text: took on an apprentice for a season
milestones.post: An apprentice. When did this happen?

milestones.text: had work bought by a collector
milestones.post: A collector bought one. A collector!

milestones.text: was asked to judge the art at the local fair
milestones.post: Judging the fair. Tough job, happy to do it.

milestones.text: made the best piece of their life and knew it
milestones.post: Best thing I've made. I know it.

milestones.text: had a piece become well known around town
milestones.post: People know this one now.

sessions.text: Made three quick studies and liked one of them.
Spent ages on one small corner of the piece.
Started over and felt better for it.
Tried a new subject just to see.
Worked by the window until the light went.
Stepped back, squinted, and kept going.
Tidied the supplies, which counts as art too.
Stopped at a good point instead of overworking it.
Looked at the work of someone admired for inspiration.
Made a mess and enjoyed it.
Took notes on what to try next time.
Got into a lovely quiet rhythm.
Showed a friend the work in progress and got a useful comment.
Lost an hour to fiddly details.
Kept it loose and quick today.
Fixed one thing that had been bothering them for days.
Wandered outside in search of something worth making.
